architecture.initialization: down normal std=1/sqrt(feature_dim); up exactly zero
architecture.routing: replace only z_0.90; preserve original z_0.60/z_0.70/z_0.80/z_0.95
architecture.scoring: D1A force attainable 0.90 active; existing multi-anchor mean aggregation

data.ranking: train2863 deployed plus hop<=1 strict 0.90 boundary states only
data.drift_reference: all train2863 deployed states plus query-balanced stratified one-hop non-boundary states

training_if_authorized.relative_l2_drift: mean(||delta_h||_2^2 / (||h||_2^2 + 1e-12)) over ranking and reference states
training_if_authorized.sampling: state-equal ranking; query-balanced reference; no raw-pair-frequency averaging
training_if_authorized.checkpoint: final epoch only; no internal or development selection

internal_research_gate.practical_value: at least one new 0.90 repair and zero 0.90 breaks
internal_research_gate.historical_10_events: descriptive only; never a GO threshold
